Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Trade Marketeer position at Van de Velde. My background as a digital marketer, specializing in SEO, content, and web optimization, aligns well with your focus on driving sell-out and enhancing brand visibility for wholesale partners.

In my recent roles, I have leveraged analytics tools like Google Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and optimize online initiatives. I have a proven track record of managing website content through platforms like WordPress, developing SEO-focused content, and implementing strategies that measurably grow organic traffic for clients. My fluent English and working knowledge of Dutch further enable effective communication within your international environment.

I am eager to apply my digital expertise and collaborative approach to support Van de Velde’s global trade marketing strategy, contributing to impactful online and offline activations. Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to discussing how my skills can benefit your team.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Trade Marketeer position at Van de Velde, as advertised. I am drawn to this role by its focus on translating global brand strategy into impactful activations for wholesale partners, with a clear aim to drive sell-out and strengthen brand visibility, both online and offline. My profile as a digital marketer, skilled in SEO, content, and web optimization, offers a solid foundation for contributing to these goals.

My experience centers on enhancing digital presence and driving measurable organic growth. In my roles, I have developed and executed on-page SEO strategies, conducted keyword research, and crafted SEO-optimized content that ranks effectively. I am proficient in technical SEO audits, structured data implementation, and utilizing tools such as Google Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs to monitor performance and extract actionable insights. This expertise directly supports the need to define and drive high-impact online initiatives that strengthen brand presence and consumer engagement.

Furthermore, I possess robust experience as a Content Platform owner and in CMS content management, regularly publishing and updating web content for client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and Rank Math. This background enables me to effectively contribute to developing and optimizing a local marketing toolbox and ensuring consistent brand messaging. My work has involved building and maintaining comprehensive websites, such as mirook.com, showcasing my ability to manage projects from structure to content integration and social media. I also have experience supporting teams in building digital workplace sites, indicating a collaborative approach to achieving broader organizational objectives.

My analytical capabilities extend to leveraging data for continuous improvement, identifying opportunities, and defining best practices. I am highly adaptable, proactive, and results-oriented, as demonstrated by my consistent efforts to automate repetitive tasks and take initiative in optimizing digital assets. Fluent in English, with a working knowledge of Dutch, I am well-equipped to engage with diverse stakeholders across your international operations.

Thank you for considering my application. I am confident that my blend of digital marketing acumen and technical skills can significantly contribute to Van de Velde’s trade marketing success. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss this exciting role further.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Proven track record in SEO, keyword research, and content optimization, consistently driving organic traffic and enhancing online visibility for client websites.
- Proficient in managing website content, publishing blog posts, and maintaining platforms using WordPress, Elementor, and Rank Math, ensuring consistent brand presence.
- Skilled in leveraging Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to analyze website performance, track results, and derive actionable insights.
- Experience in building and optimizing multi-page websites, implementing technical SEO, and coordinating content and site structure, demonstrating project execution capabilities.
- Fluent in English and possess working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking), facilitating effective communication across international teams and partners.
